name: Forge3D
summary: Desktop OpenSCAD modeling IDE with preview packages for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
requirements: The macOS v3.1.0 DMG is an unsigned development preview
Node.js 22+ and npm 10+ for source builds
OpenSCAD language-server support is limited to Windows development builds
highlights: OpenSCAD editor with native OpenSCAD render loop
Three.js viewport with orbit, pan, zoom, grid, axes, and dimension overlays
Parameter controls from OpenSCAD variables and // @param annotations
File open/save, STL export, recent files, and workspace browser
Surface measurement and non-destructive through-hole assembly tools
Published v3.1.0 preview packages for Windows, macOS, and Linux
